Plot a voter's 3D utility surface over 2D policy space

plot_utility_surface.Rd

Renders the utility function \(u(x, y)\) as an interactive 3D surface using Three.js (WebGL). The surface peaks at (ideal_x, ideal_y) and falls off according to loss_config and dist_config. Horizontal slices through the surface at fixed utility levels correspond to the 2D indifference curves produced by level_set_polygon_2d and ic_polygon_2d.

Drag the plot with the mouse to rotate the surface.

Usage

plot_utility_surface(
  ideal_x,
  ideal_y,
  dist_config = make_dist_config(),
  loss_config = make_loss_config("quadratic"),
  xlim = c(-3, 3),
  ylim = c(-3, 3),
  resolution = 60L,
  n_levels = 5L,
  axis_labels = c("Dimension 1", "Dimension 2"),
  title = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

Arguments

ideal_x, ideal_y

Numeric scalars: voter ideal-point coordinates.

dist_config

Distance configuration from make_dist_config. n_weights must be 2.

loss_config

Loss configuration from make_loss_config.

xlim, ylim

Numeric vectors of length 2: policy-space extents. Defaults to c(-3, 3) for both axes.

resolution

Integer: number of grid points per axis. Higher values produce smoother surfaces. Default 60L.

n_levels

Integer: number of indifference rings to draw on the surface. Default 5L.

axis_labels

Character vector of length 2: labels for the two policy dimensions. Default c("Dimension 1", "Dimension 2").

title

Optional character string for a plot title.

width, height

Widget width and height in pixels.

Value

An htmlwidget object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Euclidean distance + quadratic loss (circular tent)
plot_utility_surface(
  ideal_x = 1, ideal_y = 0.5,
  dist_config = make_dist_config("euclidean"),
  loss_config = make_loss_config("quadratic")
)

# Manhattan distance produces a diamond-shaped tent
plot_utility_surface(
  ideal_x = 0, ideal_y = 0,
  dist_config = make_dist_config("manhattan"),
  loss_config = make_loss_config("linear"),
  axis_labels = c("Guns", "Butter"),
  title = "Voter C utility surface"
)
} # }
